# Postres Silve project guidance

- Keep customer-facing copy in Spanish and use the Postres Silve name.
- Preserve the restrained pastel palette, black-and-white cake mark, and responsive layouts.
- The homepage lives in `src/app/page.tsx`; shared visual rules live in `src/app/globals.css`.
- Product data and pricing are sample content. Do not imply live fulfillment, payment, or newsletter storage without implementing those services.
- Run `npm run lint` and `npm run build` after meaningful changes.
